title: About Frosted Systems Bass Ridge
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1210 recent saved-signal files and 314 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Anchor image material 1 and YouTube Music Library, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Frosted Systems Bass Ridge: Frosted acrylic systems slab, architectural section, side-lit object plate: long translucent cyan ribs surge from the lower foreground into pale bloom, wide near the viewer and compressed upward. A large left void becomes dark teal illegible aperture-masses, not text. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against monumental cyan rib slab across center, deep lower cyan pressure ridge, and matte scuffed concrete trough between ribs.
